description.narrative:
Insatsen avser ett kärnstöd till GAP för perioden 2016-2018. GAP är en civilsamhällesorganisation som grundades 2007 i Kosovo. GAPs vision är att bygga ett demokratiskt samhälle som garanterar individuell, politisk och ekonomisk frihet for alla dess medlemmar. Organisationen arbetar för att uppnå detta genom två program: 1.) God samhällsstyrning (good governance), inom vilket organisationen bedriver påverkansarbete samt bevakar och informerar om offentliga institutioners arbete och 2.) Utvecklingspolicier, inom vilket GAP bedriver forskning och erbjuder policyrekommendationer för offentliga styrdokument och lagar.
Inom programmet god samhällsstyrning finns ett flertal pågående projekt som berör bland annat bevakning av kommunalpolitik, uppföljning av landets statsbudget, bevakning och publicering av regeringsbeslut, och information om banksektorn. Inom programmet för utvecklingspolicier pågår projekt som berör energisektorn, privatsektorutveckling, effektivitet i statliga företag, samt vägtransport, säkerhet och miljö.

This contribution is a core support to GAP Institute for advanced studies (GAP) 2016-2018. GAP is a non-governmental organisation, established in Kosovo in 2007. GAP's vision is to build a democratic society that guarantees individual, political and economic freedom for all its members. In order to reach this vision the organisation works with two programmes: 1.) Good governance, which includes advocacy and monitoring of public institutions, and 2.) Development Policies, which includes policy research and recommendations pertaining to public policies and laws.
Within the programme for Good governance there are a number of on-going projects covering amongst others: monitoring municipalities; scrutinising the state budget; monitoring and communicating on governmental decisions; and, comparisons and information regarding the banking sector. Within the programme for Development Policies there are currently projects in the following areas: the energy sector, private sector development, effectiveness of public enterprises and car/road traffic policies.

This intervention is in the form of core support and consequently does not have a specific intended outcome. GAP's overall objectives are to bridge the gap between the governance and citizens and between problems and solutions for the advancement of Kosovo society. GAPs key objectives for the period 2016-2018 are to:
1.Further organizational growth; to increase the level of policy documents; to expand the research scope; to strengthen its human resources; and to widen the advocacy activities.
2.Contribute to evidence-based public policies, by providing evidence-based policy recommendations to decision makers, first and foremost to those parliamentary committees whose scope of work falls under GAP's expertise, as well as with other public institutions responsible for economic development and social welfare.
3.Enhance road transport policies, by pressing for a change of government's policies in terms of; used cars not based on age but on Euro standards; substantial improvements in technical control of car safety and emission standards; and a full implementation of the Strategy on Air Quality.
4.Contribute to a competitive private sector, by providing research on fiscal policies, industrial policies, financial incentives and the overall environment of doing business.
5. Maintain a high media presence. Last year GAP Institute was cited 753 times only by online news media. Media in Kosovo plays a major role in creating opinions and advocating for new policies. Therefore, one of GAP's objectives will be maintaining the same level of presence in the media.

Throughout the time that Sida has been funding GAP Institute, Sida assesses that GAPs work have had positive outcomes.
To start with, GAP is an independent research institute and Think Tank, researching and writing reports that is available for anyone to read, such as government, civil society, citizens, private sector and international actors. The independence of the institute plays a big role as different actors, such as the government do not influence the research being conducted.
By bridging the gap between the governance and citizens, facts and different perspectives regarding problems and solutions GAP undertakes policy relevant research. GAP monitors the work of public institutions, advocates for good governance, and provides concrete recommendations on public policy.
The reports on current political relevant areas reflect facts and figures that are presented in a communicative clear way, which is being used by different stakeholders. GAP also participates in, and sometimes arranges, round table discussions and debates which makes GAP also being a platform for sharing problems and solutions. All of this is linked to the specific goals and thematic areas mentioned in the 12 goals/areas above, with room for new topic to dig into.
GAP has contributed to more transparent and honest research that also influence policy making, development efforts and raising awareness in the society. The core support from Sida has not had any detailed expected outcome on a project level, which has given GAP possibility to be flexible, follow trends, decide themselves (based on the strategy) what to focus on.
However, the above 12 goals can be assessed as to many to follow up on even though some is more clear in regard of what GAP has achieved (and have had possibility to achieve). See further down more reflections for future similar interventions.
Influence over political reforms and municipalities is an area in which Sida assesses that there have been important positive outcomes. For example, GAP created a municipal budget transparency index. The result from this was an increase of the transparency in the government between the years 2017-2023, increasing from 39%-57,5%. The creation of the index also led to that the Ministry of Finance implemented more transparency within the national budget. This not only contributes to the transparency within Kosovo, but also helps supporting the country in the development process. (GAP, narrative report, 1/1-2016 à 31/12-2024)
Within the field of gender equality GAP has through its research contributed to positive results for gender equality. An example is the research GAP conducted on gender quotas in public enterprises. This research led to the adoption of 40% quota. Research that GAP also conducted on parental and maternity leave also led to reforms aiming to strengthen the support for women in the workforce.
Another important result has been the annual studies of how the mayors, those who won the election, have fulfilled their promises. The results of the studies have always been published on-line and been of great interest for media.
Overall, GAP is a very trusted Think Tank in Kosovo, that has also been able to engage in discussions and influence stakeholders in Kosovo with its research, which shows on a clear engagement from GAP and that the institution has had an impact on the society. The core support from Sida was also used for competence development among the staff, which strengthened their own institution.
As the support have been core support, no very specific objectives have been set out, which is why unexpected results is a bit harder to assess. However, something that is worth noting is that GAP's work has been mentioned and used several times, especially from the Kosovo government but also from World Bank or other research Institutes - as well as in the media. Examples of this is when Institute for Democracy and Economic Analysis (IDEA), replicated GAPs work of monitoring the municipalities and the work of the mayors in North Macedonia. (GAP, narrative report, 1/1-2016 à 31/12-2024) (GAP, narrative report, 1/1-2023 à 31/12-2023) (GAP, narrative report, 1/1-2016 à 31/12-2024)
Finally; during the years GAP has produced policy papers and reports that have been appreciated by many actors, as mentioned above. Yearly around 10 reports are produced - including all kind of policy paper, totally every year 16 policy papers are produced. During the latest years the content has been about Kosovar's migration, analysis of the municipal budget, public administration reform, taxes, gender equality, the financial impact of the European Union measures on Kosovo, emigration and the labor market i Kosovo.
Sida assesses that GAP as a source for relevant, interesting and needed statistics and information plus analysis is a crucial and most useful.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
